### 5013

**Drive Mode**

Msetter: Drive. One picture per press, bursts, intervals or brackets.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Single)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name | Not on |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Single |  |
| 5 | Continuous - low speed |  |
| 7 | Continuous - high speed |  |
| 2 | Interval Shooting | M11-D |
| 8 | Exposure Bracketing | M11-D |

### D0D5

**Shutter Type**

Msetter: Shutter. Electronic is silent. Hybrid adds the electronic shutter for speeds faster than 1/4000.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 2 (Hybrid)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Mechanical |
| 1 | Electronic |
| 2 | Hybrid |

### D097

**Selftimer**

Msetter: Self-timer. Waits before taking the picture.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Off)
- Cameras: all

The self-timer delay (M-EV1 manual p.109).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 3 | Self-timer 2 s |
| 1 | Self-timer 12 s |

### D198

**Long Exposure Noise Reduction**

Msetter: Long exposure noise reduction. Takes a second, dark exposure of the same length to remove noise. Doubles the wait.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (On)
- Cameras: all

Noise reduction for long exposures (M-EV1 manual p.71).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | On |

### D007

**Bracketing Aperture**

Msetter: Bracketing step. How far apart the bracketed pictures are.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1000 (1 EV)
- Cameras: all

Written in thousandths of a stop: -667 is -2/3 EV.

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 333 | 1/3 EV |
| 667 | 2/3 EV |
| 1000 | 1 EV |
| 1333 | 1 1/3 EV |
| 1667 | 1 2/3 EV |
| 2000 | 2 EV |
| 2333 | 2 1/3 EV |
| 2667 | 2 2/3 EV |
| 3000 | 3 EV |

### D000

**Interval Frames**

Msetter: Interval pictures. How many pictures an interval series takes.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from 1 to 9999
- Factory value: 300
- Cameras: all

### D001

**Interval Time (s)**

Msetter: Interval seconds. Time between interval pictures.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from 1 to 89999
- Factory value: 2
- Cameras: all

Seconds between pictures in an interval series. 89999 is 24 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds.

### D050

**Digital Zoom**

Msetter: Digital zoom. Crops the picture to look like a longer lens.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 2 (Off)
- Cameras: all

Crops the picture by 1.3x or 1.8x (M-EV1 manual p.66).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 2 | Off |
| 3 | 1.3x |
| 4 | 1.8x |

### D197

**Digital Shift Assistant**

- Kind: one of a list of numbers
